name: Casablanca
source:
The representative of Felidae Corporation.
The company runs the super AI known as "CAT-2" that created "nekos".
A charismatic genius girl who had turned every decision she's made into the right one.
and also the originator of "NekoFes"

-Appeared in NEKOPARA Love Project Vol 1 and Vol 4
